paragraphs: R' Yose, his son, a Tanna of a baraita. [Megillah 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.7a.13).[^1]

notes.text: The linked baraita names Rabbi Yose ben Dormaskit. [Heilprin’s Dormaskit entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=911&lang=en) also says “Rabbi Yose, his son.” [Heilprin’s entry on Rabbi Yose of Dormaskit](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1910&lang=en) cites this same baraita and argues that Dormaskit is his father’s name. Heilprin also mentions the place-name Damascus.
